# Proposed tickets (generated by build_plan.py from plan_data.py) - after the corrective loop

Placeholders `PT-*`; the Operator allocates real `T-IGX-NN-L` ids. Commit trailer `Ref: governance/tickets/<id>.md` is required on every commit touching `intergrax/ agents/ applications/ scripts/`. Nothing here is approved; each ticket needs a plan digest + `Approved:` line (AR-38) before work.
`sens`: PRODUCT = ACT-N11 (breaks IIAC activation until RB-2) | MATERIAL = IIAC material governance path | NONPRODUCT = tests/scripts/workflows | DOCS | SETTINGS = GitHub (separate authorization) | RUN/SESSION = not a repo ticket but needs an authorization.
